test_labels_dtypes: test MultiIndex labels dtypes are correctly chosen as int8, int16, or int32 based on level size
test_values_boxed: test MultiIndex.values returns a boxed numpy array of tuples from from_tuples input
test_values_multiindex_datetimeindex: test MultiIndex.values correctly preserves DatetimeIndex elements for naive and timezone-aware levels
test_values_multiindex_periodindex: test MultiIndex.values correctly preserves PeriodIndex elements when constructed from arrays
test_consistency: test MultiIndex construction with large and inconsistent codes works correctly
test_hash_collisions: test MultiIndex hash collision handling with get_indexer and get_loc under monkeypatched size cutoff
test_take_invalid_kwargs: test MultiIndex.take raises TypeError for unexpected kwargs and ValueError for unsupported parameters
test_isna_behavior: test MultiIndex raises NotImplementedError when calling pd.isna on the index
test_large_multiindex_error: test MultiIndex KeyError messages for out-of-bounds labels with large and small size cutoffs
test_mi_hashtable_populated_attribute_er: test MultiIndex hashtable populated attribute error handling with monkeypatched size cutoff
test_can_hold_identifiers: test MultiIndex._can_hold_identifiers_and_holds_name returns True for a valid key
test_metadata_immutable: test MultiIndex levels, codes, and names are immutable and raise TypeError on mutation
test_level_setting_resets_attributes: test MultiIndex.set_levels correctly resets cached attributes like is_monotonic_increasing
test_rangeindex_fallback_coercion_bug: test MultiIndex from_product preserves integer dtypes after concat and stack operations
test_memory_usage: test MultiIndex.memory_usage returns correct byte counts and accounts for hashtable caching
test_nlevels: test MultiIndex.nlevels returns the expected number of levels
